thesis.text: PTSB is in the final stages of a court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement to be acquired by BAWAG PSK; shareholder approval is secured (30 July 2026) and the Irish High Court Sanction Hearing is scheduled for 27 October 2026, with regulatory approval as the remaining key condition [uk:9758782 p.1]. Deal risk is now primarily regulatory/court process risk rather than shareholder approval risk.
